items.statement: The independently computed ordering supports the qualitative author hypothesis of electron transfer from the lower-work-function anatase phase toward higher-work-function rutile phase and is consistent with a built-in field, within the clean-facet model boundary.
items.expected: The conclusion links the submitted ordering to anatase-to-rutile electron transfer, states the model boundary, and does not claim that work functions alone prove the entire Z-scheme mechanism.
